#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {
        reader.rdbuf(cin.rdbuf());
    }
    string next() {
        while (!(cin >> token)) {
            // ignore
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
private:
    string token;
    istream& reader = cin;
};

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        if (n >= 100) {
            out << 0 << endl;
            return;
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> points(n + 1, vector<long long>(5));
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                points[i][j] = in.nextInt();
            }
        }

        vector<bool> bad(n + 1, false);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (i == j || j == k || k == i) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    long long v1[5], v2[5];
                    for (int t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
                        v1[t] = points[j][t] - points[i][t];
                        v2[t] = points[k][t] - points[i][t];
                    }

                    double dot = 0;
                    long long norm1Sq = 0;
                    long long norm2Sq = 0;
                    for (int t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
                        dot += v1[t] * v2[t];
                        norm1Sq += v1[t] * v1[t];
                        norm2Sq += v2[t] * v2[t];
                    }

                    double val = dot / sqrt(norm1Sq) / sqrt(norm2Sq);
                    if (acos(val) * 180.0 / M_PI + 0.000000001 < 90.0) {
                        bad[i] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad[i]) count++;
        }
        out << count << endl;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad[i]) {
                out << i << endl;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    ostream& out = cout;
    TaskC task;
    task.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
